summary_1line: Arjuna halts the Kaurava host, magically creates water and an arrow-built shelter for his horses, and resumes his furious advance toward Jayadratha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Amid the raging battlefield, Arjuna shoots an arrow into the earth and a clear lotus-filled lake suddenly springs forth for his exhausted horses.
Arjuna stands alone against a sea of chariots and elephants, arrows blazing through the sky like sparks from a great fire.
Krishna calmly leads the wounded horses into a hall made entirely of arrows while enemy armies watch in stunned silence.
